layouts.purpose: Executive overview with spacious evidence cards

Side-by-side evidence; exact before/after metrics from dataset_comparison

authoring: Provide brief and sections to create_document. Bind numbers as {{e<EVIDENCE_ID>.r<ZERO_BASED_ROW>.<COLUMN>}}. Evidence IDs refer to current build_report receipts. Full tables, charts and sources remain in the appendix.
company_templates: Optional template_attachment_id for a DOCX or 16:9 PPTX uploaded in the same chat. Preserves DOCX headers/footer, or PPTX master artwork, with generated content. Review previews; arbitrary original page layouts are not reproduced.
revision: inspect_document then create_document with revise_artifact_id, base_version and section_patches. Exact frozen data and unpatched sections remain; logical sections may span multiple physical pages.
